title: Let holy company cool the body
summary: Holy company cools the body before the mind can settle. Return the mind to better company before it scatters again.
takeaway: Return the mind to better company before it scatters again.
lifeApplication: Before adding another plan, give the restless heart one quiet place to stay.

source.shortMeaning: Holy company cools the body before the mind can settle.
source.lifeApplication: When agitation reaches the body, sit where patient people remember God.

evidence.coreClaim: Holy company cools the body before the mind can settle.
evidence.turn: Let this stay with you: bring your searching to holy company and let it cool there.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before adding another plan, give the restless heart one quiet place to stay.
